record.Description: This recall involves QIOMALA-branded pressure washers with model number “HWT12P”. The 1.2 GPM electric pressure washers were sold in green with black and in blue with black and measure about 14 inches deep, 11 inches wide and 15 inches high. The pressure washers came with a 500 ml soap tank, four quick disconnect nozzles and a 20-foot hose. Model number “HWT12P” is printed on a label on back of the unit, near the power cord entry point.
record.Title: QIOMALA Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards

Hazards.Name: The recalled pressure washers lack an adequate-length power cord, which can encourage use of an extension cord, posing a serious risk of injury or death from shock and electrocution hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact QIOMALA for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to unplug the pressure washer, cut the power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed power washer, showing the model number, to QIOMALA@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product.

ai.summary: QIOMALA has recalled its model HWT12P electric pressure washers because the power cord is too short. This issue may lead people to use extension cords, creating severe shock and electrocution risks that can cause critical injury or death.
ai.next_steps: Stop using the pressure washer right away and contact QIOMALA to obtain a full refund. You should unplug the device, cut the power cord in half, take a picture of the cut unit displaying the model number, email the photo to QIOMALA@163.com, and throw the destroyed machine away.
